claims.evidence: No capacity markings or stamps legible on either cylinder in any photo.
No test date, stamp, or certification label visible or legible on the cylinder neck.
Leak testing cannot be done from static photos; no hiss/soap-bubble test shown.
Photos 0, 1 and 2 all show no regulator/valve fitted at all — only a plain plug or brass nut on the neck.

risks.risk: No valve/regulator is actually fitted, contrary to the seller's explicit claim
risks.proof: Close-up photo or short video showing a valve assembly screwed onto the neck, ideally with a brand/date stamp visible
risks.if_unproven: priced as cylinder only, no valve included, needing separate valve purchase

risks.risk: Unknown or unreadable cylinder capacity (12.5kg unconfirmed)
risks.proof: Clear photo of the embossed capacity/weight stamp on the neck collar
risks.if_unproven: priced at the lower common capacity tier until confirmed

risks.risk: Unknown test/manufacture/expiry date — could be out of certification, illegal to refill in Lagos
risks.proof: Photo of the stamped test date ring on the collar

risks.risk: Unknown gas content — cylinder could be empty
risks.proof: Weighing video or scale photo showing gross weight vs tare weight

risks.risk: Ambiguous identity — two different cylinders (yellow, blue) shown, unclear which is for sale
risks.proof: Single clear photo/video confirming the exact cylinder being sold, with visible brand and all stamps
risks.if_unproven: priced based on the lower-value of the two shown

risks.risk: Rust spots and worn paint could indicate corrosion or structural weakness
risks.proof: Close-up of rust areas and underside/base condition

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the neck area showing an actual valve/regulator fitted, with brand and any date stamp legible
Photo of the embossed capacity/weight stamp (e.g., 12.5kg) on the collar
Photo of the test/certification date stamp ring
Weight-check video or scale reading to confirm gas content
Single unambiguous photo/video identifying exactly which cylinder (yellow or blue) is being sold
response.reason: The seller claims 'the valve is new' but every photo shows no valve or regulator fitted at all, a direct and safety-relevant contradiction on a gas cylinder sale, so the listing's credibility is in doubt before any pricing can be trusted.
